title: Cartridge artifact contracts
description: The compiled cartridge, its artifact file and the compiler and loader diagnostics (05 §8, §11, §12, §20; 08 §6; 14 §R4). R4 minimal: the frozen kinds only; rooms, NPCs, schedules, quests, dialogue, assets and localization join with their features, under a new format tag.

CompiledCartridge.description: The semantic payload a cartridge hash covers (05 §11 'Hash domains and attestations'): the manifest with its compatibility requirements, the exact capability lock (exactly requires.capabilities until a registry dependency exists; the loader rejects a difference with LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH), and the normalized definitions of the frozen kinds, each map keyed by DefinitionRefString so canonical key order orders it. A key's cartridge_id and cartridge_version are the manifest's id and version and its last segment is the definition's key; the compiler guarantees this and the loader rejects a mismatch (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); the subset cannot express it. format is the hash domain tag and selects the variant. Compatibility (PM ruling, R5 S1 review A7/F3): adding an OPTIONAL field to an existing definition kind, or an optional new definition map, keeps the tag, because an artifact without it keeps its bytes, hash and meaning; a change in the meaning or requirement of an existing field (a field made required, removed or reinterpreted) takes a new tag. Loaders stay fail-closed: an older loader rejects a field it does not know as UNKNOWN_FIELD, and kernel_api ranges govern which loader a cartridge needs. No certificate, signature, package or catalog field belongs here (CAR-10). In R4 the authored cartridge.json is exactly the CartridgeManifest object form (kernel_api as {at_least, below}, capabilities as key to version); the string forms (">=1.3 <2.0", key@version) are not accepted yet.

items.description: The cartridge's items, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind item; absent when it has none (R5 S4, an optional map: the tag stays).

npcs.description: The cartridge's NPCs, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind npc; absent when it has none (R5 S4, an optional map: the tag stays).

entry.description: The room a new run's player starts in (00a §12 manifest entry); a room of this cartridge.

oneOf.description: loka-cartridge-v2 (R5 slice 1): v1 plus rooms, the entry room and the default-locale text catalog. The compiler emits v2 exactly when the source has rooms, an entry or a text catalog, so a cartridge without rooms keeps its v1 bytes and hash.

CartridgeArtifact.description: The compiled artifact file: one canonical JSON document, built and never committed (05 §20). content_hash is the cartridge hash (CartridgeRelease.cartridge_hash): SHA-256 of the canonical bytes (loka-numeric-v1) of cartridge. It hashes cartridge only, never itself, so it can sit beside it (CAR-10); the loader recomputes it and rejects a mismatch.

ArtifactSize.description: The byte length of a cartridge artifact file, checked before decoding: at most 4 MiB (owner decision, docs/decisions/owner-decisions-r4-2026-09-25.md, item 2). bin/contracts.exs emits the maximum into kernel/ts/src/contracts.gen.ts as ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES; Elixir reads it here.

DiagnosticCode.description: A diagnostic code: a closed set, one code per distinct cause (08 §6: repair loops read codes and data, never prose). INVALID_JSON: a source file is not JSON (RFC 8259, UTF-8); in the loader, the artifact is not UTF-8 or fails the canonical decoder (loka-numeric-v1), duplicate keys included, path empty, data {}; DUPLICATE_KEY: an object in a source file repeats a key (Elixir's JSON keeps the first silently, so the compiler checks it); UNKNOWN_FIELD: a field outside the registered schema (05 §5); the validator's unknown_property; in the loader, path the validator's, data {}; SCHEMA_VIOLATION: any other schema error; data.error is its ErrorCode (error_registry.json); a v2 source (rooms, an entry or text.json) without an entry is missing_property at cartridge.entry; in the loader, path the validator's; MISSING_MANIFEST: the cartridge has no cartridge.json (05 §3); path is cartridge; DUPLICATE_DEFINITION: two definitions in one cartridge have one DefinitionRef (03 §2, 05 §4; other cartridges' refs differ, CAR-01); FACT_NAME_COLLISION: two authored fact names map to one key after each . becomes _ (owner decision, IMPORT.md); FACT_DEFAULT_INVALID: a fact default is outside its enum values or int bounds (fact.schema.json FactType); UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: a reference names no definition (CAR-02, A10); an exit's to or the entry names no room of this cartridge (05 §17), or, in v2, a room's title or description, a detail's description (path rooms/well_lane.details.bucket.description) or a description variant's (rooms/well_lane.variants[0].description) or an action's label or accessibility, or an item's or NPC's short, room_line, room-line variant or description has no text catalog entry; an item's location or an NPC's room names no definition of that kind in this cartridge; or (compiler only) a touch link in the catalog string of such a text names no target: a link's target is the detail, item or NPC it names, a link without a target key in a detail's, item's or NPC's own text is that thing itself, and a target key names a detail of the room (in a room's or its details' text), an item or an NPC of the cartridge, so a link without one in a room's own text has none (data target is then the link as written), data {target} (the DefinitionRefString or the TextKey), path the reference (rooms/ferry_landing.exits.north.to, cartridge.entry, rooms/ferry_landing.title, actions/talk.label; in the loader .cartridge.rooms["..."].exits.north.to, .cartridge.entry); CONTAINMENT_CYCLE: an item's location leads, through the items it starts in, back to itself (invariant containment_acyclic), path its location's item member (items/satchel.location.item; in the loader .cartridge.items["..."].location.item), data {}; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: more items start in an item or NPC than its capacity (invariant containment_acyclic), path its capacity (items/satchel.capacity), data {capacity, held}; TOUCH_LINK_MISSING (compiler only, severity warning, the build succeeds): a room's description or one of its description variants has no touch link to one of the room's details, or an item's or NPC's room line or one of its room-line variants has none to that item or NPC (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q3; text.schema.json TextCatalog), path the text key's member (rooms/ferry_landing.variants[0].description, items/lantern.room_line), data {target} (the detail, item or NPC key); UNREACHABLE_DETAIL: a room's detail's first alias, which names it when a lookup is ambiguous, is also an alias of another detail of that room, or has an empty word or starts with at, the, a or an, so no lookup picks it by that name (room.schema.json InspectableDetail), path the detail (rooms/ferry_landing.details.lamp_post; in the loader .cartridge.rooms["..."].details.lamp_post), data {}; UNKNOWN_COMMAND: an action's command is not in the command registry (action.schema.json ActionDefinition); in the loader, no capability owns it (capability_registry.json), path .cartridge.actions["..."].command, data {}; FACT_TYPE_MISMATCH: a fact_compare value is not of the fact's type (06 §21: typed policy AST); UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY: a key in requires.capabilities is not registered at that version (A10, Gate R4); SERVER_ONLY_CAPABILITY: an offline_private cartridge requires a server_only capability (05 §6, C4); KERNEL_API_RANGE_INVALID: the kernel_api range is empty or reversed, at_least not below below (05 §3; a malformed version string is SCHEMA_VIOLATION); PINNED_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: content_schema or rule_ir is a version the compiler or installed kernel does not implement (05 §3; both implement 1 now), data {field, declared, supported}; in the loader, path .cartridge.manifest.requires.<field>; UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY: a definition uses a command, event or policy op, or is of a definition kind (a room, a room's detail, a room's or detail's description variant), whose owning capability (capability_registry.json) the manifest does not require (05 §6), path the room file for a room (.cartridge.rooms["..."] in the loader), rooms/<key>.details.<detail> for a detail, rooms/<key>.variants[i] or rooms/<key>.details.<detail>.variants[i] for a variant, data {capability} (the owner's key), suggested_capabilities [its key@version]; in the loader, the lock lacks the owner's key, path the command or op member (.cartridge.actions["..."].command, ...policy.root.items[0].op); NESTING_TOO_DEEP: the compiled artifact would nest a definition deeper than the canonical depth limit (loka-numeric-v1), data {maximum}; the author's file is valid JSON, so this is not INVALID_JSON, while the loader reports a too-deep artifact as INVALID_JSON; ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE: the artifact file exceeds ArtifactSize, checked before decoding, path empty, data {bytes, maximum}; UNKNOWN_FORMAT: the artifact's cartridge.format is absent or neither loka-cartridge-v1 nor loka-cartridge-v2, path .cartridge.format, data {}; CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH: content_hash differs from the hash of cartridge (05 §11, CAR-05), path .content_hash, data {declared, computed}; ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH: a definition map key's cartridge_id or cartridge_version differs from the manifest's id or version, or its key from the definition's key (a policy has no key field, so only the first two apply; a kind other than its map's fails the propertyNames pattern, SCHEMA_VIOLATION); the schema cannot express this check; path the map member (.cartridge.facts["..."]), one diagnostic per differing field, data {field, declared, expected} with field cartridge_id, cartridge_version or key; LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: lock.capabilities differs from manifest.requires.capabilities for a key, which in R4 must be equal (path .cartridge.lock.capabilities.<key> even when the lock lacks it, data {capability, required, locked}, the absent side omitted); a registry-dependency closure will change this rule under a new format tag; CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED: the lock names a key@version the installed kernel lacks (05 §6), path .cartridge.lock.capabilities.<key>, data {capability: key@version}; KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED: the installed kernel_api is outside the manifest's range (05 §3), path .cartridge.manifest.requires.kernel_api, data {installed}; FACT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: loader only; the installed kernel cannot read a fact of these scopes: the TypeScript kernel hosts one private world, which has a player (the actor's CharacterId) and an instance (its WorldContextId) but no party or realm, and fact_compare names no scope, so it reads a fact at the one scope the fact allows; a fact whose scopes are not exactly one of player or instance fails, path .cartridge.facts["..."].scopes, data {}; CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED: the installed app lacks a required client feature (CAR-07), path .cartridge.manifest.requires.client_features[i], data {feature}. In the loader, suggested_capabilities is empty except for UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY. The loader checks an artifact in this order and stops at the first stage that fails, before any save mutation (CAR-07), reporting the first of that stage's diagnostics in list order (Diagnostic): ArtifactSize (ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE); canonical decode (INVALID_JSON); cartridge.format (UNKNOWN_FORMAT); CartridgeArtifact (UNKNOWN_FIELD, SCHEMA_VIOLATION); content_hash (CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH); definition keys (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); lock against requirements (LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH; UNKNOWN_COMMAND and UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY re-run against the lock: every command an action uses has an owning capability, and every command and policy op a definition uses has its owning capability's key in the lock, CAR-07; and every room's, detail's, item's, NPC's and variant's owning capability too, and the ops of every variant's condition; events join when a frozen kind references one); references (UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE, v2 only: exits, entry, text keys, and each fact_compare's fact and each has_item's item names a fact or item of this cartridge (path its fact or item member, data {target}), item and NPC text keys and locations; UNREACHABLE_DETAIL; CONTAINMENT_CYCLE; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED); the installed kernel and app (CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED, FACT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED, KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED, PINNED_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED). The loader re-checks the content_schema and rule_ir pins: the artifact crosses a trust boundary.

Diagnostic.description: A structured diagnostic (08 §6; 05 §8: every compile stage emits them). severity is error, which fails the build, except for a warning (TOUCH_LINK_MISSING), which the compiler reports beside the artifact. message_key is diagnostics. followed by the code in lowercase; data carries the code's facts as strings and integers; suggested_capabilities lists capability pins that would fix it (the key@version form requires uses), possibly none. A list of diagnostics is in one deterministic order (05 §8, CAR-04): by path, then code, comparing UTF-8 bytes, then by the canonical encoding of the whole diagnostic; an identical diagnostic appears once.

path.description: Where a diagnostic applies (08 §6). A compiler path is a source followed by steps; a loader path is steps only, relative to the artifact file, and empty for the whole file, so it is empty or starts with . or [. The source is the file's path relative to the cartridge root, / separated, without its .json extension (quests/missing_child, cartridge for cartridge.json); if a segment is not [a-z0-9_]+ or the file does not end in .json, the source is instead the whole relative path as a canonical JSON string literal (loka-numeric-v1). Steps: .name for an object member whose name is [a-z0-9_]+; ["..."] with the name as a canonical JSON string literal for any other member; [n] for array index n (decimal, no leading zeros). Example: quests/missing_child.objectives[2].target; a diagnostic about a whole file is its source alone.
